methodology.scope: Sequential full application HTTP workflow: upload through durable create, worker/model execution and GET-observed completion. Browser-visible measurements are separate artifacts with 2000ms UI polling.
methodology.workloads: Four attributed 300×300 PCB-IND patches cycled; three frozen holdout examples and one training-set serving smoke. This is performance sampling, not model evaluation.
methodology.percentiles: Nearest rank p50/p95; no p99/SLA claim from 30 samples.
methodology.temperature: Warmed after provider busy probe and real browser workflow.

firstRequest.scope: First predict after readiness; raw image transfer through JSON decode; excludes bundle/process startup and application queue

browserWorkflow.measurement: Playwright click dispatch on Upload and inspect through visible Completed heading; includes upload, durable creation, queue, trained HTTP inference, commit, browser polling and automation observation overhead.
browserWorkflow.temperature: Uncontrolled initial service state; not a cold-start claim.
browserWorkflow.fixture: PCB-IND v4 5810_t_007.jpg, training-set serving smoke fixture; not holdout evaluation.

browserWarmed.percentileMethod: Nearest rank; p95 is descriptive of these 20 samples, not an SLA; no p99 claim.
browserWarmed.measurement: Playwright click dispatch on Upload and inspect through visible Completed heading, including upload, durable creation, queue, trained HTTP inference, commit, browser polling and automation observation overhead. File selection and readiness check excluded.
browserWarmed.temperature: Warmed service after preceding trained review workflow.
browserWarmed.fixture: Same 300×300 PCB-IND v4 5810_t_007.jpg training-set smoke patch repeated; differing input distribution and workload from mock benchmark.

realBusyApplicationRetry.failureObservation: Private durable MongoDB projection; queued public DTOs intentionally omit failure details.
realBusyApplicationRetry.scope: A bounded incomplete genuine JPEG upload holds normal Python admission. Typed inference_busy traverses the real worker HTTP adapter, consumes an application attempt, then recovers through the existing backoff. This fault case is excluded from performance samples.

failure.message: The inference provider is temporarily unavailable.

slowModelRecovery.scope: Real application worker HTTP timeout while its owned trained Python container was paused, then restoration and retry. Separate from benchmark samples; no exact latency guarantee.

timeout.observationSource: Read-only Mongo observation inside the owned API container; queued REST responses omit failure metadata

slowModelRecovery.limitation: The cancelled Python request may finish after disconnect. Its internal completion was not individually observed; this probe verifies the durable timeout, bounded application retry, and stable persisted completion.

workerCrash.scope: SIGKILL after processing claim with the real model process paused; lease recovery completed a later attempt. Python may finish a disconnected request after unpause; no claim that its internal completion was individually observed.
